title: Hop and carry one
html_source:
A limping gait. Apparently a characteristic of Hoppy Holohan’s.

He was mentioned once before, in markedly similar fashion, in episode 5: “Who was telling me? Holohan. You know Hoppy?” And he makes a one-line appearance in the hallucinatory Circe episode. That’s the extent of his participation in Ulysses. He plays a more significant role in “The Mother” in Dubliners.

http://m.joyceproject.com/notes/050028hoppy.html
